as_told.title: Gallimore and Strassman develop the DMTX protocol

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore says that in 2015 he and a colleague, Rick Strassman, put forward a model and paper for what they called extended-state DMT, or DMTx: a way to keep a person in the experience of DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, for much longer than usual. He says the work did not end there and is still going on, and he tells it because longer visits could let people explore what he describes as a realm of other beings.
